supportedClaims: Bounded unitary OpenQASM 2 classification with persisted input and Harness execution provenance
Independent Qiskit matrix replay up to 8 qubits at a maximum-entry tolerance of 1e-9, or exact source identity within the 16-qubit scientific audit scope
outOfScope: Physical hardware, noise, measurements, resets, classical control and arbitrary include paths
Strict mathematical proof for arbitrary floating-point rotations, automatic acceptance of relative phase or probabilistic classifications
Passed independent acceptance for different circuit pairs above the 8-qubit dense reference budget

checks.criterion: Both inputs satisfy the scientific audit scope: unitary OpenQASM 2, at most 16 qubits, 65536 UTF-8 bytes and 512 statements per circuit. This scope does not restrict Tool execution.
Raw UTF-8 input SHA-256, qubit counts, statement counts and byte counts match the persisted request.
Pinned MQT QCEC 3.10.0, timeoutSeconds=0 (no backend timeout, subject to host resource policy) and finite timing facts are present.
The classification is deterministic strict/global-phase equivalence or non-equivalence; other classifications produce a warning.

Independent Qiskit parsing validates finite unitary semantics, including custom-gate bodies, before source-identity proof or complete-unitary replay supports the original classification. Positive maximum-entry tolerance is 1e-9; negative classification requires a residual above 1e-8. Unavailable references or values between these margins warn and remain conditional.
Harness materialized and reread the request, analysis artifact and Result Package with a real call/result event range.
